ios.desc:
One Wikipedia article, chosen for you each day.

dailypedia reimagines the wiki rabbit hole as a calm daily reading ritual. No endless feed. No noise. Just one article tuned to what you cannot help being curious about.

Start by choosing the worlds and topics that draw you in. dailypedia turns those choices into a personal map of your curiosity, then uses it to select your daily article.

Read it, like it, or skip it. Each small signal helps shape tomorrow’s pick. Over time, even readers who begin with the same topics can follow entirely different paths.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Choose what interests you

Choose from 18 broad worlds and refine your interests across 64 topics. It takes about 60 seconds.

2. Shape your curiosity

Your choices create your starting profile, so the first recommendation already reflects your interests.

3. Read one article each day

Open a Wikipedia article selected for you and read at your own pace. There is no endless feed and nothing pushing you toward the next distraction. When you are done, you are done.

WHY DAILYPEDIA?

• One personalized Wikipedia article each day
• Recommendations that adapt to your interests
• 18 worlds and 64 topics to shape your starting profile
• A calm, focused reading experience
• No endless feed or pressure to keep scrolling
• A different path of discovery for every reader

Turn curiosity into a daily reading habit. Learn something unexpected, then come back tomorrow to open another door.

NOTE: Articles are sourced from Wikipedia. dailypedia is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Wikimedia Foundation.
